title: Nearby alerts
master_help: We let you know when a dog or cat goes missing in your area.
locked_note: Possible matches and messages in the app cannot be turned off, so you never miss anything important.
quiet_help: We will not disturb you during quiet hours, except for a chip-number match and new messages.
email_unverified: Confirm your email address to get email notifications.
email_sent: We have sent the link. Please check your email.
push_denied: Notifications are turned off in your phone settings.
reminders_separate: Your phone notices on its own when you are near where an animal went missing. This is separate from the alerts above: pausing alerts does not stop these reminders.
reminders_label: Alert me when I am near a lost animal
reminders_help: Local alerts on the phone: at most {cap} a day, never in quiet hours. Your location stays on the phone.
reminders_lost: We turned the reminders off because your phone no longer allows location Always. Allow it in your phone settings, then switch them back on here.
reminders_no_location: We cannot find your phone's location right now. Please try again in a moment.
